title: TLS: Regression on EAP, PEAP, with TLS conversations handling
description:
The code added for handling the conversations with deinterlacing had a side effect on EAP-like protocols. Both Ethernet and non-Ethernet cases are impacted.

Fix also the Follow TLS Stream when the deinterlacing is used.

Fixes #21027

AI-Assisted: no
